entities.summary: Max Lundgren was a Swedish author of children's books. He debuted in 1962 with the book Hunden som äntligen visslade, and wrote over 50 books. Some of his books have become TV series, among other Pojken med guldbyxorna and his books about fictional Swedish football club Åshöjdens BK.
